issue.title: Sterlite Copper, Thoothukudi
issue.summary: The Thoothukudi copper smelter (Sterlite/Vedanta): decades of pollution and health complaints, the 2018 anti-expansion protests and police firing that killed 13, the state's closure order and court rulings up to the Supreme Court in 2024, what closure did to India's copper trade and local livelihoods, and later public claims that opposition to industrial projects is foreign-funded or sabotage. Facts, claims and hypotheses are kept apart.
issue.edition: public: confirmed, reported and disputed facts plus attributed claims. Inferred events, inferred links and hypotheses are kept in the local research edition only.

events.summary: Said at an interaction with civil-services aspirants in Chennai; cited FCRA-funded NGOs, produced no documents in the reporting read. DMK's Kanimozhi: 'I condemn the governor who is defaming the people's struggle.' The Governor also made similar claims about the Kudankulam protests.

events.title: IT Minister Vaishnaw (NDTV): Apple's Indian manufacturing faced 'food poisoning', cut electricity wires and 'fake news'; 'they tried all tricks'
events.summary: Cited the 2021 Foxconn incident. He named no country, group or party. The 'hidden forces' wording attributed to him in some retellings was NOT found in the reports read; his terms were 'people' and 'those who oppose'. The public record on s19 (rats, drainage, failed samples; Apple probation) does not establish deliberate sabotage.
events.claim_text: 'Remember, when Apple's manufacturing started, some people did food poisoning.' 'Electricity wires were cut. There were many such incidents.' 'People didn't like India to come up as a manufacturer; they tried all tricks.' 'We will face cyber attacks... They will also try to do all kinds of physical attacks.' (Business Today, 21 Sep 2026, NDTV interview; wording as paraphrased in reports, not a transcript)
